name: Home Energy Assistance Program (HEAP, fuel assistance)
rule: Gross household income at or below 60% of estimated State Median Income
documents_needed: Photo ID for head of household
Heating bill info (company name, account number)
Proof of income for the 30 days before applying
notes: Not all income counts; local agency decides. Official page shows size 8 as '$142, 207' (typo); stored as 142207. Sizes 11+: ask agency.
